title: torch.compile + CUDAGraph + gradient accumulation fails

labels.name: triaged
labels.description: This issue has been looked at a team member, and triaged and prioritized into an appropriate module

labels.name: module: cuda graphs
labels.description: Ability to capture and then replay streams of CUDA kernels

body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

I'm using `torch.compile(mode='reduce-overhead')` with gradient accumulation. Even after marking the start of each step and cloning the output of the graph, I get:

> RuntimeError: Error: accessing tensor output of CUDAGraphs that has been overwritten by a subsequent run.

This behavior was reported on the forums as well: https://discuss.pytorch.org/t/error-accessing-tensor-output-of-cudagraphs-that-has-been-overwritten-by-a-subsequent-run/218415

And they provided an excellent minimal repro script (which also fails for me):

```py
import torch
import torch.nn as nn

device = 'cuda'
model = nn.Linear(10, 1).to(device)
model = torch.compile(model, fullgraph=True, mode='reduce-overhead')

for _ in range(5):
    torch.compiler.cudagraph_mark_step_begin()

    input = torch.randn((10,), dtype=torch.float32, requires_grad=True, device=device)
    outputs = model(input).clone()
    loss = outputs.sum().clone()
    loss.backward()
```

with the following output:

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/home/sharvil/test.py", line 13, in <module>
    loss.backward()
    ~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^
  File "/home/sharvil/.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/torch/_tensor.py", line 625, in backward
    torch.autograd.backward(
    ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^
        self, gradient, retain_graph, create_graph, inputs=inputs
        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
    )
    ^
  File "/home/sharvil/.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/torch/autograd/__init__.py", line 354, in backward
    _engine_run_backward(
    ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^
        tensors,
        ^^^^^^^^
    ...<5 lines>...
        accumulate_grad=True,
        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
    )
    ^
  File "/home/sharvil/.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/torch/autograd/graph.py", line 841, in _engine_run_backward
    return Variable._execution_engine.run_backward(  # Calls into the C++ engine to run the backward pass
           ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
        t_outputs, *args, **kwargs
        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
    )  # Calls into the C++ engine to run the backward pass
    ^
RuntimeError: Error: accessing tensor output of CUDAGraphs that has been overwritten by a subsequent run. Stack trace: File "/home/sharvil/.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/torch/_dynamo/external_utils.py", line 68, in inner
    return fn(*args, **kwargs). To prevent overwriting, clone the tensor outside of torch.compile() or call torch.compiler.cudagraph_mark_step_begin() before each model invocation.
```

### Versions

PyTorch versions:

- 2.6.0+cu124
- 2.7.1+cu126
- 2.9.1+cu128
